content_blocks.text: 14 August 2026
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: By Amardeep Gill
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: International law firm Trowers & Hamlins has been named as a supplier on the Government Commercial Agency (GCA) Legal Panel for Public Sector framework (RM6374). The appointment reinforces the firm's longstanding reputation and commitment to supporting public sector organisations across the UK with multidisciplinary expertise and legal advice.
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Trowers has been appointed to the following lots under the framework:
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 1a – Full Legal Service Provision for all Public Sector
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 1b – Full Legal Service Provision for Local Government and Local Communities
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 1c – Full Legal Service Provision for Health and Social Care
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 2 – Focused Legal Support
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 3 – Litigation and Disputes
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Lot 4 – Projects and Complex Advice including Public Private Partnerships (PPP)
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Through these lots, public sector organisations will be able to access a comprehensive range of legal services spanning commercial, corporate, governance, procurement, real estate, development, employment, litigation, projects, regeneration, infrastructure and other specialist areas. The framework is designed to provide public sector buyers with flexible access to both full-service legal support and specialist expertise for complex and strategically important matters.
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Amardeep Gill, Partner and National Head of Public Sector, said:
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: "We are delighted to have been appointed to the Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel for Public Sector framework. This appointment reflects the continued strength and breadth of our public sector practice and our commitment to helping public sector organisations navigate complex legal, commercial and strategic challenges. We look forward to continuing our work with public sector clients across the UK, supporting them to deliver effective services and achieve positive outcomes for the communities they serve."
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: Trowers has a market-leading public sector practice and advises central government departments, local authorities, NHS bodies, combined authorities, housing providers, universities and other public sector organisations. The firm combines deep sector knowledge with multidisciplinary legal expertise, innovative technology and a collaborative approach to help clients deliver successful outcomes and achieve value for money.
heading_path: Trowers named as supplier on Government Commercial Agency's Legal Panel

content_blocks.text: GCA is the UK's central commercial and procurement organisation, connecting public and private sectors to achieve the best outcomes for the UK and its citizens. GCA uses its commercial expertise to create a simpler procurement experience that redirects valuable resources into essential public services, creating value for the nation.
